verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בַּשְּׁלִישִׁ֖י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·’a·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh baš·šə·lî·šî bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the eleventh . . . year on the first day of the third month the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: No undécimo ano, no terceiro mês, ao primeiro dia do mês, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶל־ הֲמוֹנ֑וֹ אֶל־ מִ֖י דָּמִ֥יתָ בְגָדְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ’ĕ·mōr ’el- par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim wə·’el- hă·mō·w·nōw ’el- mî dā·mî·ṯā ḇə·ḡā·ḏə·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Son of man say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude . . . Who can be compared to your greatness
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, dize a Faraó e à sua multidão: A quem és semelhante na tua grandeza?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אַשּׁ֜וּר אֶ֣רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֗וֹן יְפֵ֥ה עָנָ֛ף וְחֹ֥רֶשׁ מֵצַ֖ל וּגְבַ֣הּ קוֹמָ֑ה וּבֵ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים הָיְתָ֖ה צַמַּרְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’aš·šūr ’e·rez bal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn yə·p̄êh ‘ā·nāp̄ wə·ḥō·reš mê·ṣal ū·ḡə·ḇah qō·w·māh ū·ḇên ‘ă·ḇō·ṯîm hā·yə·ṯāh ṣam·mar·tōw
verses.literal: Look at Assyria a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches that shaded the forest It towered on high its top was among the clouds
verses.literalPt: Eis que Assíria era um cedro do Líbano, de ramos formosos, de ramagem sombria e de alta estatura; e a sua copa se achava entre a densa ramada.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם גִּדְּל֔וּהוּ תְּה֖וֹם רֹֽמְמָ֑תְהוּ אֶת־ נַהֲרֹתֶ֗יהָ הֹלֵךְ֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת מַטָּעָ֔הּ וְאֶת־ תְּעָלֹתֶ֣יהָ שִׁלְחָ֔ה אֶ֖ל כָּל־ עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ma·yim gid·də·lū·hū tə·hō·wm rō·mə·mā·ṯə·hū ’eṯ- na·hă·rō·ṯe·hā hō·lêḵ sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ maṭ·ṭā·‘āh wə·’eṯ- tə·‘ā·lō·ṯe·hā šil·ḥāh ’el kāl- ‘ă·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: The waters made it grow the deep springs made it tall directing their streams all around its base and sending their channels to all the trees of the field
verses.literalPt: As águas nutriram-no, o abismo fê-lo crescer; os seus rios corriam em torno do seu plantio; e ele mandou os seus regatos a todas as árvores do campo.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ גָּבְהָ֣א קֹמָת֔וֹ מִכֹּ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וַתִּרְבֶּ֨ינָה סַֽרְעַפֹּתָ֜יו וַתֶּאֱרַ֧כְנָה פֹארָתוֹ מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים בְּשַׁלְּחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên gā·ḇə·hā qō·mā·ṯōw mik·kōl ‘ă·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh wat·tir·be·nāh sar·‘ap·pō·ṯāw wat·te·’ĕ·raḵ·nāh p̄ō·rå̄·ṯō mim·ma·yim rab·bîm bə·šal·lə·ḥōw
verses.literal: Therefore . . . it towered higher than all the trees of the field Its branches multiplied and its boughs grew long as it spread them out because of the abundant waters
verses.literalPt: Por isso, se elevou a sua estatura sobre todas as árvores do campo; multiplicaram-se os seus ramos e alongaram-se as suas varas por causa das muitas águas, quando os enviou.

verses.original: בִּסְעַפֹּתָ֤יו קִֽנְנוּ֙ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְתַ֤חַת פֹּֽארֹתָיו֙ יָֽלְד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּבְצִלּוֹ֙ יֵֽשְׁב֔וּ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bis·‘ap·pō·ṯāw qin·nū kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ pō·rō·ṯāw yā·lə·ḏū kōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇə·ṣil·lōw yê·šə·ḇū kōl gō·w·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: All the birds of the air nested in its branches and all the beasts of the field gave birth beneath its boughs all the great nations lived in its shade
verses.literalPt: Todas as aves do céu se aninhavam nos ramos dele, e, debaixo das suas varas davam à luz as suas crias todos os animais do campo, e, debaixo da sua sombra, habitavam todas as grandes nações.

verses.original: וַיְּיִ֣ף בְּגָדְל֔וֹ בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ דָּֽלִיּוֹתָ֑יו כִּֽי־ הָיָ֥ה שָׁרְשׁ֖וֹ אֶל־ מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yə·yip̄ bə·ḡā·ḏə·lōw bə·’ō·reḵ dā·lî·yō·w·ṯāw kî- hā·yāh šā·rə·šōw ’el- ma·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: It was beautiful in its greatness in the length of its limbs for its roots extended to abundant waters
verses.literalPt: Assim era ele formoso na sua grandeza, no cumprimento das suas varas, porque a sua raiz se achava junto a muitas águas.

verses.original: אֲרָזִ֣ים לֹֽא־ עֲמָמֻהוּ֮ בְּגַן־ אֱלֹהִים֒ בְּרוֹשִׁ֗ים לֹ֤א דָמוּ֙ אֶל־ סְעַפֹּתָ֔יו וְעַרְמֹנִ֥ים לֹֽא־ הָי֖וּ כְּפֹֽארֹתָ֑יו כָּל־ עֵץ֙ בְּגַן־ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ דָמָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו בְּיָפְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·rā·zîm lō- ‘ă·mā·mu·hū bə·ḡan- ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·rō·wō·šîm lō ḏā·mū ’el- sə·‘ap·pō·ṯāw wə·‘ar·mō·nîm lō- hā·yū kə·p̄ō·rō·ṯāw kāl- ‘êṣ bə·ḡan- ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō- ḏā·māh ’ê·lāw bə·yā·p̄ə·yōw
verses.literal: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it the cypresses could not compare with its branches nor the plane trees match its boughs No . . . tree in the garden of God could compare with its beauty
verses.literalPt: Os cedros do jardim de Deus não o podiam esconder; os ciprestes não eram como os seus ramos, e os plátanos não eram como as suas varas; nenhuma árvore do jardim de Deus se assemelhava a ele na sua formosura.

verses.original: יָפֶ֣ה עֲשִׂיתִ֔יו בְּרֹ֖ב דָּֽלִיּוֹתָ֑יו וַיְקַנְאֻ֙הוּ֙ כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ עֵ֔דֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּגַ֥ן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: yā·p̄eh ‘ă·śî·ṯîw bə·rōḇ dā·lî·yō·w·ṯāw way·qan·’u·hū kāl- ‘ă·ṣê- ‘ê·ḏen ’ă·šer bə·ḡan hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: I made it beautiful with its many branches the envy of all the trees of Eden which were in the garden of God
verses.literalPt: Fi-lo formoso pela multidão dos seus ramos; de maneira que tiveram inveja dele todas as árvores do Éden, que havia no jardim de Deus.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּבַ֖הְתָּ בְּקוֹמָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֤ן צַמַּרְתּוֹ֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ין עֲבוֹתִ֔ים וְרָ֥ם לְבָב֖וֹ בְּגָבְהֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ă·šer gā·ḇah·tā bə·qō·w·māh way·yit·tên ṣam·mar·tōw ’el- bên ‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯîm wə·rām lə·ḇā·ḇōw bə·ḡā·ḇə·hōw
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Since it became great in height and set its top . . . among the clouds and it grew proud . . . on account of its height
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto é elevado em estatura, e se elevou a sua copa entre a densa ramada, e o seu coração se levantou na sua altura,

verses.original: וְאֶ֨תְּנֵ֔הוּ בְּיַ֖ד אֵ֣יל גּוֹיִ֑ם עָשׂ֤וֹ יַֽעֲשֶׂה֙ ל֔וֹ כְּרִשְׁע֖וֹ גֵּרַשְׁתִּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’et·tə·nê·hū bə·yaḏ ’êl gō·w·yim ‘ā·śōw ya·‘ă·śeh lōw kə·riš·‘ōw gê·raš·ti·hū
verses.literal: I delivered it into the hand of the ruler of the nations for him to deal with it according to its wickedness I have banished it
verses.literalPt: entregá-lo-ei nas mãos do poderoso das nações; certamente, este há de tratar com ele. Eu o lancei fora por causa da sua maldade.

verses.original: וַיִּכְרְתֻ֧הוּ זָרִ֛ים עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם וַֽיִּטְּשֻׁ֑הוּ אֶל־ הֶ֠הָרִים וּבְכָל־ גֵּ֨אָי֜וֹת נָפְל֣וּ דָלִיּוֹתָ֗יו וַתִּשָּׁבַ֤רְנָה פֹֽארֹתָיו֙ בְּכֹל֙ אֲפִיקֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֵּרְד֧וּ מִצִּלּ֛וֹ כָּל־ עַמֵּ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ וַֽיִּטְּשֻֽׁהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·rə·ṯu·hū zā·rîm ‘ā·rî·ṣê ḡō·w·yim way·yiṭ·ṭə·šu·hū ’el- he·hā·rîm ū·ḇə·ḵāl gê·’ā·yō·wṯ nā·p̄ə·lū ḏā·lî·yō·w·ṯāw wat·tiš·šā·ḇar·nāh p̄ō·rō·ṯāw bə·ḵōl ’ă·p̄î·qê hā·’ā·reṣ way·yê·rə·ḏū miṣ·ṣil·lōw kāl- ‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ way·yiṭ·ṭə·šu·hū
verses.literal: Foreigners the most ruthless of the nations cut it down and left it Its branches have fallen on the mountains and in every valley its boughs lay broken in all the earth’s ravines And all the peoples of the earth left its shade and abandoned it
verses.literalPt: Uns estrangeiros, os terríveis das nações, o exterminaram, e o deixaram; sobre os montes e em todos os vales, caíram as suas varas, e os seus ramos estão quebrados junto a todas as correntes da terra; todos os povos da terra se retiraram da sua sombra e o deixaram.

verses.original: עַל־ מַפַּלְתּ֥וֹ יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶל־ פֹּארֹתָ֣יו הָי֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- map·pal·tōw yiš·kə·nū kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·mā·yim wə·’el- pō·rō·ṯāw hā·yū kōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk and all the beasts of the field lived among its boughs
verses.literalPt: Sobre a sua ruína habitarão todas as aves do céu, e todos os animais do campo estarão sobre as suas varas;

verses.original: לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ לֹא־ יִגְבְּה֨וּ בְקוֹמָתָ֜ם כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ מַ֗יִם וְלֹֽא־ יִתְּנ֤וּ אֶת־ צַמַּרְתָּם֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים וְלֹֽא־ יַעַמְד֧וּ אֵלֵיהֶ֛ם בְּגָבְהָ֖ם כָּל־ שֹׁ֣תֵי מָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ כֻלָּם֩ נִתְּנ֨וּ לַמָּ֜וֶת אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּת֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָ֖ם אֶל־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer lō- yiḡ·bə·hū ḇə·qō·w·mā·ṯām kāl- ‘ă·ṣê- ma·yim wə·lō- yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- ṣam·mar·tām ’el- bên ‘ă·ḇō·ṯîm wə·lō- ya·‘am·ḏū ’ê·lê·hem bə·ḡā·ḇə·hām kāl- šō·ṯê mā·yim kî- ḵul·lām nit·tə·nū lam·mā·weṯ ’el- ’e·reṣ taḥ·tîṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê ’ā·ḏām ’el- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: This happened so that no other trees by the waters would become great in height and set their tops among the clouds and no other well-watered . . . trees would reach them in height . . . For they have all been consigned to death to the depths of the earth among the mortals . . . . . . who descend to the Pit
verses.literalPt: para que nenhuma de todas as árvores junto às águas se exalte na sua estatura, nem levante a sua copa entre a densa ramada, nem se levantem na sua altura os seus poderosos, sim, todos os que bebem água, porque todos eles estão entregues à morte, às partes inferiores da terra, no meio dos filhos dos homens, juntamente com os que descem à cova.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה בְּי֨וֹם רִדְתּ֤וֹ שְׁא֙וֹלָה֙ הֶאֱבַ֜לְתִּי כִּסֵּ֤תִי עָלָיו֙ אֶת־ תְּה֔וֹם וָֽאֶמְנַע֙ נַהֲרוֹתֶ֔יהָ וַיִּכָּלְא֖וּ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וָאַקְדִּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְבָנ֔וֹן וְכָל־ עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה עָלָ֥יו עֻלְפֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·yō·wm riḏ·tōw šə·’ō·w·lāh he·’ĕ·ḇal·tî kis·sê·ṯî ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- tə·hō·wm wā·’em·na‘ na·hă·rō·w·ṯe·hā way·yik·kā·lə·’ū ma·yim rab·bîm wā·’aq·dir ‘ā·lāw lə·ḇā·nō·wn wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh ‘ā·lāw ‘ul·peh
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says On the day it was brought down to Sheol I caused mourning I covered the deep because of it I held back its rivers its abundant waters were restrained I made Lebanon mourn for it and all the trees of the field fainted because of it
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: No dia em que ele desceu ao Sheol, fiz que houvesse luto. Por causa dele, cobri o abismo e retive os seus rios, e ficaram paradas as grandes águas; e fiz que o Líbano o pranteasse, e todas as árvores do campo desfaleceram por causa dele.

verses.original: מִקּ֤וֹל מַפַּלְתּוֹ֙ הִרְעַ֣שְׁתִּי גוֹיִ֔ם בְּהוֹרִדִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ שְׁא֖וֹלָה אֶת־ י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר וַיִּנָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ תַּחְתִּית֙ כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ עֵ֔דֶן מִבְחַ֥ר וְטוֹב־ לְבָנ֖וֹן כָּל־ שֹׁ֥תֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl map·pal·tōw hir·‘aš·tî ḡō·w·yim bə·hō·w·ri·ḏî ’ō·ṯōw šə·’ō·w·lāh ’eṯ- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr way·yin·nā·ḥă·mū bə·’e·reṣ taḥ·tîṯ kāl- ‘ă·ṣê- ‘ê·ḏen miḇ·ḥar wə·ṭō·wḇ- lə·ḇā·nō·wn kāl- šō·ṯê mā·yim
verses.literal: I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall when I cast it down to Sheol with those who descend to the Pit Then all the trees of Eden the choicest and best of Lebanon all the well-watered trees . . . were consoled in the earth below
verses.literalPt: Fiz estremecer as nações ao som da sua queda, quando o lancei no Sheol juntamente com os que descem à cova; e todas as árvores do Éden, as escolhidas e as melhores do Líbano, todas as que bebem água, foram consoladas nas partes inferiores da terra.

verses.original: גַּם־ הֵ֗ם אִתּ֛וֹ יָרְד֥וּ שְׁא֖וֹלָה אֶל־ חַלְלֵי־ חָ֑רֶב וּזְרֹע֛וֹ יָשְׁב֥וּ בְצִלּ֖וֹ בְּת֥וֹךְ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gam- hêm ’it·tōw yā·rə·ḏū šə·’ō·w·lāh ’el- ḥal·lê- ḥā·reḇ ū·zə·rō·‘ōw yā·šə·ḇū ḇə·ṣil·lōw bə·ṯō·wḵ gō·w·yim
verses.literal: They too descended with it to Sheol to those slain by the sword As its allies they had lived in its shade among the nations
verses.literalPt: Juntamente com ele, desceram ao Sheol os que foram mortos à espada, sim, desceram com ele os que foram o seu braço e que habitavam debaixo da sua sombra, no meio das nações.

verses.original: אֶל־ מִ֨י דָמִ֥יתָ כָּ֛כָה בְּכָב֥וֹד וּבְגֹ֖דֶל בַּעֲצֵי־ עֵ֑דֶן וְהוּרַדְתָּ֨ אֶת־ עֲצֵי־ עֵ֜דֶן אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֤ים תִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב ה֤וּא פַרְעֹה֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’el- mî ḏā·mî·ṯā kā·ḵāh bə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ū·ḇə·ḡō·ḏel ba·‘ă·ṣê- ‘ê·ḏen wə·hū·raḏ·tā ’eṯ- ‘ă·ṣê- ‘ê·ḏen ’el- ’e·reṣ taḥ·tîṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘ă·rê·lîm tiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ hū p̄ar·‘ōh wə·ḵāl hă·mō·nōh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Who then is like you in glory and greatness among the trees of Eden You also will be brought down to the depths of the earth to be with the trees of Eden . . . You will lie among the uncircumcised with those slain by the sword This is Pharaoh and all his multitude declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: A quem és assim semelhante em glória e em grandeza entre as árvores do Éden? Contudo, serás precipitado juntamente com as árvores do Éden às partes inferiores da terra; no meio dos incircuncisos, te deitarás juntamente com os que forem mortos à espada. Este é Faraó e toda a sua multidão, diz o Senhor Jeová.
